scope: Canonical reconstruction of 9 Android and 9 iOS core mobile screens with degraded/truth-state siblings

android_frame.layout: TopAppBar with Odia subtitle, sticky district filter chip carousel, 2-column staggered AtlasPlaceCard feed, AtlasNavigationBar.
android_frame.degraded_sibling_frame: FRAME_AND_01_DISCOVER_OFFLINE (shows OfflineBanner docking under TopAppBar, cached badge on previously loaded cards, offline indicator).

ios_frame.layout: Large NavigationTitle ('Discover') in New York serif, horizontal capsule filter bar, full-width EditorialPlaceCard list, standard iOS TabBar.
ios_frame.degraded_sibling_frame: FRAME_IOS_01_DISCOVER_OFFLINE (shows OfflineStatusBanner with wifi.slash, cached status badges, and offline district pack indicator).

android_frame.layout: Collapsible PlaceHeroMedia with verified photo badge, Odia script title block, PlacePracticalInfo grid, PlaceTruthSection with survey agency, ExtendedFAB navigation trigger.
android_frame.degraded_sibling_frame: FRAME_AND_02_PLACE_DETAIL_UNVERIFIED_HOURS (displays amber candidate chip for holiday visiting hours; clearly labels unverified schedule).

ios_frame.layout: Edge-to-edge photo gallery with pagination dots, Inset Grouped sections for Visiting Info, Cultural Heritage, and Provenance, top navigation bar with bookmark item.
ios_frame.degraded_sibling_frame: FRAME_IOS_02_PLACE_DETAIL_OFFLINE (displays local SQLite cached record with 'Saved to Offline Atlas' confirmation pill).

android_frame.layout: MapLibre dark basalt vector map canvas, custom vector pins, SelectedMapEntitySheet at 280dp peek detent showing place summary, walking distance band, and bus connection.
android_frame.degraded_sibling_frame: FRAME_AND_03_MAP_LOCATION_DENIED (shows LocationStateIndicator with slash, manual district selector button, and straight-line estimate notice).

ios_frame.layout: MapKit vector map canvas, custom Annotation glyphs, native SwiftUI sheet presented at .fraction(0.35) detent with compact place row and navigation button.
ios_frame.degraded_sibling_frame: FRAME_IOS_03_MAP_LOCATION_DENIED (shows location-denied notification banner with 'Select Starting District' dropdown).

android_frame.layout: Duration segmented buttons (Half-day, 1-day, 3-day), Pace selector chips, Transport preference toggles, NaturalLanguageRefinement text box with AI Assistant badge.
android_frame.degraded_sibling_frame: FRAME_AND_04_PLAN_INPUT_OFFLINE (disables AI text box; presents deterministic rule-based generator with offline catalog templates).

ios_frame.layout: Inset Grouped Form with native segmented Pickers for Duration and Pace, transport mode toggles, grounded prompt text field with AI disclaimer.
ios_frame.degraded_sibling_frame: FRAME_IOS_04_PLAN_INPUT_OFFLINE (shows 'Offline Planning' mode with deterministic filter controls).

android_frame.layout: Sticky itinerary header with total duration and distance, scrollable ItineraryDayCards, JourneyLegRows indicating scheduled bus departures and walking segments.
android_frame.degraded_sibling_frame: FRAME_AND_05_ITINERARY_UNCONFIRMED_FARES (explicitly labels bus fares as 'Unconfirmed / Pay on Bus' with null fare pill).

ios_frame.layout: Editorial day sections with New York chapter titles, continuous timeline list connecting stops, transit leg disclosures with timetable timestamps.
ios_frame.degraded_sibling_frame: FRAME_IOS_05_ITINERARY_TRANSIT_CANDIDATE (displays amber candidate disclosure on legs involving unverified bus stops).

android_frame.layout: ActiveTripHeader with progress bar (e.g., 'Stop 3 of 6'), ActiveMilestoneCard with prominent 'Arrived' button, vertical TripTimeline with completed/skipped rows.
android_frame.degraded_sibling_frame: FRAME_AND_06_ACTIVE_TRIP_OFFLINE (runs 100% offline; manual check-in active; displays offline pack indicator).

ios_frame.layout: Pinned progress gauge toolbar, high-visibility milestone card with swipe-to-complete, list of upcoming destinations with estimated arrival times.
ios_frame.degraded_sibling_frame: FRAME_IOS_06_ACTIVE_TRIP_OFFLINE (confirms local SQLite autonomy with zero network calls).

android_frame.layout: Route summary banner (Mo Bus 10), route terminal pill, split map showing surveyed polyline, scrollable stop sequence with StopTimelineRows and ScheduledDepartureRows.
android_frame.degraded_sibling_frame: FRAME_AND_07_TRANSIT_CANDIDATE_DISCLOSURE (shows candidate stop with dashed outline and disclaimer: 'GPS coordinates unverified by field survey').

ios_frame.layout: MapKit polyline header, bottom sheet with route timetable, stop list in Inset Grouped style, Scheduled departure timestamps in SF Mono.
ios_frame.degraded_sibling_frame: FRAME_IOS_07_TRANSIT_GEOMETRY_UNAVAILABLE (straight-line dashed connection between stops with geometry confidence chip).

android_frame.layout: Active trip banner card with 'Resume Trip' CTA, horizontal carousel of Saved Itineraries, 'Create New Plan' floating button, AtlasNavigationBar.
android_frame.degraded_sibling_frame: FRAME_AND_08_TRIPS_EMPTY (EmptyContentState showing 'No saved trips yet', with action button to browse curated temple trails).

ios_frame.layout: Large NavigationTitle ('Trips'), Section for Active Exploration, Inset Grouped list of Saved Journeys, toolbar '+' button for new plan.
ios_frame.degraded_sibling_frame: FRAME_IOS_08_TRIPS_EMPTY (ContentUnavailableView with 'airplane.circle' icon and 'Explore Odisha Atlas' button).

android_frame.layout: Traveler profile card, Offline District Packs manager (storage usage bar, Puri/Konark pack status), Contribution history, Language selector (English / Odia), App info.
android_frame.degraded_sibling_frame: FRAME_AND_09_YOU_STORAGE_LOW (shows storage warning banner when device storage is below 500MB).

ios_frame.layout: Inset Grouped Settings list: Downloaded Regions, Civic Contributions, Language & Script, About O-TRAVELZ & Open-Meteo attribution.
ios_frame.degraded_sibling_frame: FRAME_IOS_09_YOU_OFFLINE (indicates offline pack status with green checkmark for downloaded regions).

totals.cross_platform_cloning: STRICTLY_ZERO (Android uses M3 Expressive structures; iOS uses Apple HIG Inset Grouped / Detent structures)
